verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs list first-party plugins for magic link, passkey, and email-otp as sign-in extensions. The homepage advertises passkeys and magic links and shows a passkey() plugin in config, and a hands-on community report says the passkey plugin took about 7 lines of server code. The 2FA plugin's email/SMS OTP is a second factor, not passwordless sign-in, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs for the magic link and email OTP flows (each is only named), independent corroboration of magic link and email OTP, and WebAuthn-specific detail beyond the passkey plugin name.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods
